seoTitle: OCPS Calendar 2026–27: Dates, Breaks & Official PDF
seoDescription: See the 2026–27 OCPS calendar with the first and last days of school, breaks, student holidays, make-up days, and the official district PDF.
heroSummary:
Orange County Public Schools (OCPS) begins classes on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, and the last day of school is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Spring break runs March 15–19, 2027, and students return from winter break on Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

Four currently scheduled no-school dates may be used to recover instructional time after severe weather closures.

customSections.label: OCPS Severe Weather Make-Up Days
customSections.content: OCPS identifies four dates that may be used to recover instructional time after severe weather closures. These dates are currently scheduled as student holidays or other no-school days, but they may be converted to instructional days if OCPS loses class time. The superintendent may waive some make-up days or recover instructional time by extending Wednesday schedules or the school year. If those options are exhausted, OCPS will use the prioritized dates.

rows: Professional day / student holiday / teacher non-workday

customSections.label: Wednesday Early Release
customSections.content: Unless OCPS announces otherwise, Wednesdays are early-release days. Bus routes generally run one hour earlier, but dismissal times vary by school, so families should check their campus bell schedule. Weekly early-release times are not included in the ICS file.

whatsNew.title: What's Different From 2025–26
content: Both school years begin on August 11, although the weekday changes from Monday in 2025 to Tuesday in 2026.
The last day moves from May 27 in 2025–26 to May 26 in 2026–27.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for OCPS in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Students begin classes on Tuesday, August 11, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for OCPS?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Wednesday, May 26, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is OCPS spring break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027. March 12 is a teacher workday, and students return Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: When do OCPS students return after winter break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a teacher workday, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Which OCPS dates may become severe weather make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: OCPS lists February 15, April 23, November 23, and November 24 as prioritized make-up days. Their use may change if instructional time is lost.

calendarFaqs.q: Are Wednesdays early-release days in OCPS?
calendarFaqs.a: Unless otherwise announced, every Wednesday is an early-release day and buses run one hour earlier. Exact dismissal times vary by school.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the OCPS calendar download update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import. Check the official OCPS calendar page for later revisions or make-up-day changes.

sourceReviewSummary: Verified against the official OCPS 2026–27 school calendar, its severe weather make-up schedule, the OCPS calendars page, and the district’s Wednesday early-release guidance. The 2025–26 calendar was reviewed for the year-over-year comparison.
sourceReviewDetails: We checked every date shown in the districtwide calendar table against the official OCPS 2026–27 school calendar PDF.
The PDF’s second page lists potential severe weather make-up days in this priority order: February 15, April 23, November 23, and November 24.

OCPS states that the superintendent may waive some make-up days or recover instructional time by extending Wednesday schedules or the school year. If those options are exhausted, OCPS will use the prioritized dates.
The recurring Wednesday early-release rule comes from OCPS transportation guidance and is not included as a weekly event in the ICS file.
